package timerreset

import (
    "fmt"
    "runtime"
    "testing"
    "unsafe"
)

type unit struct{}
type lsfTimerSlot struct { token [2]uint64; weak unsafe.Pointer; callback bool }
type lsfTokenResult struct { tag, padding uint32; generation, id uint64 }
type lsfUnitResult struct { tag, failure byte }
type timer struct { isChan bool; lsfToken [2]uint64; lsfSlot uint32; active bool }
type timeTimer struct { timer; isFake bool }
type g struct { lsfOwner [2]uint64; bubble *byte }
type lsfTimerWait struct { token [2]uint64; stopped bool; done chan unit }
type taskState struct { timerWaits []*lsfTimerWait }
var state *taskState
var lsfTimerSlots []lsfTimerSlot
var lsfTimerCallbacks uint32
var lsfActivationActive = true
var currentG = g{lsfOwner: [2]uint64{8,88}}
var raceenabled = false
var lastID uint64
var hostOwners map[[2]uint64]bool
var retiredOld chan struct{}
var enteredFence chan struct{}

func getg() *g { return &currentG }
func nanotime() int64 { return 100 }
func racerelease(unsafe.Pointer) {}
func fatal(s string) { panic(s) }
func lsfFail(s string) { panic(s) }
func lsfMaybeWakeTimerDrain() {}
func controlledFenceReceive(wait *lsfTimerWait) { close(enteredFence); <-wait.done }
func (t *timer) stop() bool { previous := t.active; t.active=false; return previous }
func (t *timer) reset(_, _ int64) bool { previous := t.active; t.active=true; return previous }
func internal_weak_runtime_registerWeakPointer(p unsafe.Pointer) unsafe.Pointer { return p }
func internal_weak_runtime_makeStrongFromWeak(p unsafe.Pointer) unsafe.Pointer { return p }
func lsfTimerStart(_ int64, _ int32, _ int64, _ int32, _, _ int64, result unsafe.Pointer) {
    lastID++
    token := [2]uint64{7,lastID}
    hostOwners[token]=true
    *(*lsfTokenResult)(result)=lsfTokenResult{generation:token[0],id:token[1]}
}
func lsfTimerStop(generation,id int64,result unsafe.Pointer) {
    token:=[2]uint64{uint64(generation),uint64(id)}
    if !hostOwners[token] { panic(fmt.Sprint("unknown original owner ",token)) }
    delete(hostOwners,token)
    *(*lsfUnitResult)(result)=lsfUnitResult{}
    if retiredOld != nil && token==[2]uint64{7,1} { retiredOld<-struct{}{} }
}
func fixture() (*timeTimer,*lsfTimerWait) {
    lsfTimerSlots=nil; lsfTimerCallbacks=0; lastID=1
    hostOwners=map[[2]uint64]bool{{7,1}:true}
    old:=&timeTimer{timer:timer{isChan:true,active:true}}
    lsfInstallTimer(&old.timer,[2]uint64{7,1})
    wait:=&lsfTimerWait{token:[2]uint64{7,1},done:make(chan unit)}
    state=&taskState{timerWaits:[]*lsfTimerWait{wait}}
    enteredFence=make(chan struct{})
    retiredOld=nil
    return old,wait
}
func liveSlots() [][2]uint64 {
    var slots [][2]uint64
    for _,slot:=range lsfTimerSlots { if slot.token[1]!=0 { slots=append(slots,slot.token) } }
    return slots
}
func TestSequentialResetsKeepOneOwner(t *testing.T) {
    timer,_:=fixture(); state.timerWaits=nil
    resetTimer(timer,200,0); resetTimer(timer,300,0)
    if len(hostOwners)!=1 || len(liveSlots())!=1 { t.Fatalf("owners=%v slots=%v",hostOwners,liveSlots()) }
}
func TestOverlappingResetsKeepOneOwner(t *testing.T) {
    runtime.GOMAXPROCS(1)
    timer,wait:=fixture(); retiredOld=make(chan struct{},1)
    firstDone:=make(chan bool,1)
    go func(){ firstDone<-resetTimer(timer,200,0) }()
    <-enteredFence
    if !wait.stopped || timer.lsfToken != [2]uint64{} { t.Fatalf("first reset did not reach its pending fence: stopped=%v token=%v",wait.stopped,timer.lsfToken) }
    select { case <-firstDone: t.Fatal("original wait did not hold the first reset"); default: }
    secondActive:=resetTimer(timer,300,0)
    replacement:=timer.lsfToken
    if !hostOwners[replacement] || len(hostOwners)!=1 { t.Fatalf("second reset owner=%v token=%v",hostOwners,replacement) }
    close(wait.done)
    firstActive:=<-firstDone
    final:=timer.lsfToken
    slots:=liveSlots()
    if len(hostOwners)!=1 || len(slots)!=1 || hostOwners[replacement] || final==replacement {
        t.Fatalf("overlapping resets left hostOwners=%v slots=%v replacement=%v current=%v firstActive=%v secondActive=%v",hostOwners,slots,replacement,final,firstActive,secondActive)
    }
}
